purpose: Daily growth of small USA and Australia surfboard-maker brands

brands.name: Sauritch Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped polyurethane and epoxy surfboards from Greg Sauritch in Encinitas — shortboards, fishes, mid-lengths, guns, and longboards built for San Diego waves.

models.name: Accelerator
models.description: Accelerator This is your high performance surfboard for those rare & powerful winter days, that require a little more length. Add this surfboard to your travel quiver or bring it along when Blacks is firing. Equipped with a thin rail for sensitivity and a pulled-in tail, give this surfboard extra holding power after steep,critical take-offs. Order the Sauritch Accelerator as a tri fin and add about 2" to 4" to your standard shortboard. Try this model as an epoxy surfboard and it will really fly!

models.name: After Burner
models.description: After Burner A fun summer fish surfboard for small to medium surf. Works well as a tri fin, twin with small trailing fin or as a quad. This is a more high performance fish, when compared to the Sauritch Speed Quad, due to its narrower overall outline. Works in snappier summer conditions and comes with a single concave, blending into a double concave between the fins. This model is really fast down-the-line, especially when ordered as an epoxy surfboard.

models.name: Blunt Nose
models.description: Blunt Nose The Blunt nose has parallel rails, which enables you to ride this board shorter than a standard, narrow nosed surfboard. It catches waves easily, making for a great wave count at all breaks. You can ride this board with any fin setup that you have on your favorite board.

models.name: Booster
models.description: Booster The Booster has a wide diamond tail, which is perfect for boosting airs and driving hard off the bottom. This surfboard is loose and fast with an incredible amount of maneuverability. It comes with a slight single concave that blends into deeper double concaves and a small amount of "V" in the tail. This surfboard has good rail to rail smoothness and pivots sharply off the tail. The Sauritch Booster is a great summer surfboard and is really light and fast as an epoxy.

models.name: Cal Cruiser 2
models.description: Cal Cruiser 2 The California Cruiser 2, is similar to the original California Cruiser, with the exception of a slightly narrower nose, along with more nose and tail rockers, making this model more performance- oriented. The California Cruiser 2 can be ordered as a 2+1, tri fin, 5 fin, quad or a twin fin.

models.name: California Cruiser
models.description: California Cruiser The California Cruiser is a great mid length surfboard, for catching plenty of waves and long rides, during crowded conditions. It's a fluid, wave riding machine, that paddles well, while maintaining maneuverability and stability. The California Cruiser is usually ridden between 6'-10" and 7'-6", but can be ordered as short as 6'-4". With a wider nose , for paddling ease, the tail is pulled in like a shortboard, giving it holding power in steeper conditions. This board can work as your all around board, because it can adapt to almost any wave type.

models.name: CRT
models.description: CRT The CRT is a really good surfboard for any quiver. When the surf is good and powerful, the roundtail is a perfect board for holding in on critical, tight bottom turns. The narrowness of the tail, in the last 12" of the surfboard, keeps the fins firmly in place during the turn. This board is suited for hollower beach breaks or any solid surf, wherever it can be found.

models.name: CRT2
models.description: CRT2 The CRT 2 is a wider outlined round tail, which works really well in waves from 3 feet to overhead. This surfboard is very fluid in its turning, especially during cutbacks. It has a wide outline, giving it real paddle power, something that's needed in crowded situations. Fluid and loose, the CRT 2 can be ridden as a tri fin or with a 5 fin set up, making it adapt to any conditions that may arise. The CRT 2 loves reef breaks, but is suited for any break that has a wave. The CRT is narrower and more high performance than the CRT 2.

models.name: Droplet
models.description: Droplet The Droplet thrives in small, mushy surf, but can also be ridden in many other conditions. The bottom has a slight single concave that blends into a double concave with "V" in the last 1/3 of the surfboard. There is a good amount of overall volume, to keep this board moving through the flat sections of the wave and to make catching waves almost effortless. Order the Droplet with 5 fin boxes and experiment in different conditions. Ride this surfboard a few inches shorter than your height or become a real wave dominator and order it as tall as your height!!

models.name: Fisheye
models.description: Fisheye The Fisheye surfboard is a fun summer fish for small to medium surf. This surfboard works best as a twin fin, but can easily adapt to any fin combo. The Fisheye is a lot of fun in very small surf, but can adapt to medium sized waves. It has constant curve and pulls way in, at the tail, for tighter, snappier turning. The bottom design is a single concave, with a double concave between the fins. This model is very fast and pivoty and holds in well off the bottom. Perfect for San Diego surfing.

models.name: Gun
models.description: Gun This surfboard is the "big daddy" of the Sauritch Gun series and is meant for maxed-out surf, such as Maverick's or Jaws. This is the final step toward big wave riding. Usually ridden from 8'-0" to 10'-6"+. Try one on for size! There are several models in the Sauritch Surfboards gun series.

models.name: High Performance
models.description: High Performance The High Performance longboard is usually ordered narrower than a standard nose rider and has quite a bit more rocker, for maneuverability. This surfboard comes with very tapered rails for sensitivity during turns and comes standard with a large fin box and 2 sidebites, available in either FCS or Future fin systems. This is a great longboard for tighter and more aggressive turning and can be ordered as an epoxy surfboard.

models.name: Hybrid
models.description: Hybrid The Sauritch Hybrid is simply a narrower version of the Speed Egg, with a more pulled-in outline. The narrower nose is easier to penetrate the lip, which can be a big drawback of wider noses. This surfboard can catch a lot of waves easily and works well in most conditions. Ride this surfboard as a tri fin or as a 5 fin combo. The Hybrid can be really fun to ride in San Diego as an epoxy surfboard.

models.name: Launcher
models.description: Launcher The Launcher model has a slight hip above the fins, giving it plenty of drive and the ability to launch airs with ease. The Sauritch Launcher is a loose board, that is maneuverable and handles well in small to slightly overhead surf. It is a great high performance surfboard designed as a tri fin, but can be ridden as a quad. Many customers have commented on it's overall performance as an XTR epoxy surfboard.

models.name: Long Fish
models.description: Long Fish The Sauritch Long Fish will aid in catching more waves, when the surf is smaller and when crowds are dense. Instead of hopping on a longboard, you can take out the Long Fish and still manage to gain speed, while making sharper turns, than a longer surfboard. For those who love the feel of a twin fin and its speed, it's a fun choice for many conditions.

models.name: Mahi Mahi
models.description: Mahi Mahi The Mahi Mahi is a fish surfboard that works well in a wide range of surfing conditions. The Mahi Mahi has a wider outline, giving it the ability to get into waves early and fly down-the-line with plenty of speed. This fish has double concaves running between the fins with a slight "V" coming off the tail, making it turn rail to rail with ease. Try this board as a tri fin or as a quad. If you are looking for lightness and quick turning, make this an epoxy surfboard. This is another fish surfboard for surfing in San Diego.

models.name: Meddler
models.description: Meddler The Meddler is a condensed version of the Speed Egg, with a full outline and a lot of surface area for great paddling power. The medium, overall rocker, allows for easy gliding and speed, especially during mushy, summer conditions. The Meddler can be ordered as a tri fin, a five fin, a quad or with a 2+1 combo.

models.name: Microwave
models.description: Microwave The Microwave is a remake of a popular shape ridden in the 1980's. The wider outline of this surfboard helps you to paddle very well, which adds up to a higher wave count during your session. With the increasing volume of bodies in the water, it has become a challenge to catch a lot of waves, no matter where you are surfing. This is why the Microwave has been added to the Sauritch Surfboards play list. This model has a very curvy outline, which makes for plenty of maneuverability and speed. The Microwave is similar to the Sauritch Roundy model, but has an added set of wings, which pull in the tail, for more holding power during bottom turns. The bottom comes with a slight single…

models.name: Mini Egg
models.description: Mini Egg The Mini Egg is a great surfboard for catching plenty of waves and speeding down the line. This model is really fun and maneuverable and works well at reef breaks. The Mini Egg works best in small to medium surf. The rails are very soft for easy rail to rail transitioning. If you like easy turning and glide, this is the perfect surfboard for you. It's also available as an epoxy surfboard.

models.name: Mini Gun
models.description: Mini Gun The Mini Gun is a board up to 7'-4" that makes a great travel board for those days when the shortboard isn't long enough to handle late drops in pounding surf. This model has the perfect amount of rocker to keep the board turning easily, while maintaining its ability to hold well in the pocket.

models.name: Mini Longboard
models.description: Mini Longboard This is a good surfboard for someone dropping down in size from a longboard. It is simply a shorter version of a standard longboard, but turns much easier. The Sauritch Mini Longboard is very maneuverable and has great wave-catching ability. This is actually a good surfboard for a smaller person that has a hard time lugging around a 9 foot longboard!

models.name: Mini Simmons
models.description: Mini Simmons The Mini Simmons, by Sauritch Surfboards, is a fun surfboard for smaller conditions that is really quick down the line. Sauritch makes a replica of the original Simmons, but also has a modified version that comes with more modern features, such as a triple concave, quad or five fin configuration or any other custom feature desired by the customer. We will make it the way you want!

models.name: Modern Retro Fish
models.description: Modern Retro Fish The Modern Retro Fish has a slightly narrower nose than a standard retro fish, bringing the wide point down a tad and riding a little bit more like a high performance shortboard. It has constant curve in the outline, making it really maneuverable and easy to turn.

models.name: Nose Rider
models.description: Nose Rider Perfect longboard for cruising at your favorite break. Take a walk up to the nose and hang out there for awhile. The nose rider comes with a medium to full rail and a concave under the nose. This surfboard works best in small to medium size surf and comes standard with a large fin box and 2 sidebites in Future or FCS.

models.name: Performer
models.description: Performer This model has a relatively narrow outline, which is well suited for fast beach breaks or hollow reefs. Thinner rails, a deep single concave and a good amount of flip in the tail, gives this surfboard sensitivity and control during high speed turns. The Performer turns tightly in the pocket, due to its pulled in tail. This surfboard works best as a tri fin.

models.name: Pocket Rocket
models.description: Pocket Rocket The Pocket Rocket catches plenty of waves, due to it's wider outline, yet still performs well in hollower surf. The tail is pulled in by using double wings, which allows the tail to keep from spinning out during more powerful bottom turns. A triple concave comes standard on the bottom, with deeper concaves running in between the fins. This surfboard is very smooth turning and works well in small to overhead surf. Although designed as a tri fin, this model can be ordered as a 5 fin convertible. Order this surfboard 3" to 4" shorter than your standard shortboard. You can also try this model as an epoxy surfboard.

models.name: Popular
models.description: Popular This surfboard is a wider version of the Sauritch Performer model. The wider outline provides ease of paddling for bigger surfers that need that extra edge in catching waves in crowded line-ups. The Popular can be ridden in just about any conditions that mother nature offers and is the perfect surfboard for the surfer that can't afford a quiver and just needs a good, dependable board. This model is very maneuverable, while maintaining stability.

models.name: Reef Cruiser
models.description: Reef Cruiser This is an updated version of the Reef Cruiser, which comes with a wider nose, adding more paddle power, as well as more stability. This mid length/semi-gun, is a typical California round tail and is perfect for the surfer that is looking for stability and long radius turns. This is a great surfboard for reef breaks or as an all around step up, for catching waves with size, up and down the coast of California and a good travel board for most mid-sized surf. Take this board to any continent with security. The Reef Cruiser is curvier and more maneuverable than the Sauritch Tube Seeker.

models.name: Retro Fish
models.description: Retro Fish The Retro Fish is a keel fin fish that is very common in the water today. These keel fin fish are a great surfboard for cruising around in small to medium sized surf. The width in the nose helps to catch waves that nobody else on a standard shortboard can catch!

models.name: Retro Wide
models.description: Retro Wide The Sauritch Retro Wide fish is a wider, curvier board, for surfers that want to have fun, while the ocean is crowded and filled with longboards. The bottom is fairly flat toward the nose, then goes into a double concave between the fins and off the tail, with a slight V in the last 6" of the tail. The added width can aid in catching more waves, with less effort than the standard retro fish. It's the perfect solution for older surfers, as well as those who don't get the opportunity to surf as much as they once did, before a family came into their lives. Ride the Sauritch Retro wide as a twin fin or as a quad.

models.name: Roundy
models.description: Roundy The Roundy is a fun surfboard that can be ridden from 2 feet to overhead waves. It has the ability to perform smooth cutbacks and cruises through slower sections, due to its overall outline. With a wider nose and slightly pulled in tail, the Roundy catches waves easily and holds in very well on hollower waves. If you are looking for strength and lightness, you can always order your surfboard with XTR epoxy foam and epoxy resin.

models.name: Roundy Fish
models.description: Roundy Fish The Roundy surfboard is perfect for anyone who has experienced the pain from banging their foot on the tip of a typical fish tail. The Roundy solves that problem with it smooth round tail. This surfboard cuts back smoother than a fish tail, while still providing plenty of drive off the bottom. It works well as a tri fin, but can be ordered with 5 fin boxes for multiple fin configurations. This is similar to a biscuit and is a board that anyone can ride and have a lot of fun.

models.name: Speed Egg
models.description: Speed Egg This model is for the surfer wanting to transition from a longboard, while still maintaining the stability of a longboard. This surfboard catches plenty of waves and keeps you cruising through the smaller, summer surf, as well as surfing in bigger surf. The Speed Egg turns more like a shortboard, but paddles more like a longboard.

models.name: Speed Quad
models.description: Speed Quad Here is your perfect surfboard for smaller, mushier surf. This is perfect for the summer blues or if it's barely rideable. That thin, chippy board isn't cutting it in the summer slop, but you don't want to commit to a longboard. It's quick and maneuverable. Ride the Speed Quad about 4" smaller than your standard shortboard. Try it as an epoxy and really fly.

models.name: Stabilizer
models.description: Stabilizer The Stabilizer, by Sauritch Surfboards, is an all around, rounded pintail design, perfect for smooth, fluid surfing and easy cutbacks. This surfboard is wider than a standard shortboard and is very versatile for all conditions. The outline is fuller and the widepoint is above center, for easy paddling and stability. This is a great travel board, that you can always rely on, no matter where you are surfing.

models.name: Stubby
models.description: Stubby The Stubby is just a shorter and wider version of the Performer. This surfboard has a wider overall outline for slower and mushier surf. A single concave flowing into a deep, double concave allows for a great amount of speed right from the start, while the slight "V" gives it rail to rail turning capabilities. The perfect combo of tail rocker and "V" makes for ease in turning, while the wider tail gives this surfboard plenty of drive off the bottom. The Stubby is also perfect for boosting airs and performs well as a contest board in smaller conditions.

models.name: Stubby 2
models.description: Stubby 2 The Stubby 2 is just a shorter and wider version of the Stubby. This surfboard has a wider overall outline for the surfer that wants to compete in an ocean filled with longer surfboards. The Stubby 2 is a great shortboard for the person that doesn't surf as much as they used to and still wants to surf top to bottom. A single concave flowing into a deep, double concave allows for a great amount of speed right from the start, while the slight "V" gives it rail to rail turning capabilities. The perfect combo of tail rocker and "V" makes for ease in turning, while the wider tail gives this surfboard plenty of drive off the bottom. The Stubby 2 can be ridden in waves from 2 feet, up to…

models.name: Swish
models.description: Swish The Swish surfboard has a wider outline than a standard shortboard. This model works very well in smaller, mushier surf and can be used as a good contest board for those typical, smaller contest conditions. The Swish loves to be ridden in summer surf or any day that lacks any power. The flatter overall rocker and wide tail, give you the speed through the flat spots, while your narrower board tends to bog down. The single wing swallow is wide at the 12" mark for drive, then pulls in for good holding power in hollower sections of the wave. The bottom comes with a single concave, blending into a double concave with "V" toward the tail. It can be ordered as a 5 fin, which can be surfed…

models.name: Tadpole
models.description: Tadpole The Tadpole Fish is a narrower version of the Fisheye and gets the job done in small to medium surf and can go beyond, when you push its limits. With a curvy outline and small stature, this surfboard is not only loose, but able to hold in well, during tight bottom turns. The Sauritch Tadpole model works best as a twin fin, but can be used with different fin combos and can also be ordered, using epoxy construction as well as polyurethane. The Tadpole fish works well in San Diego, as well as it does in any other break.

models.name: Thug
models.description: Thug A small wave surfboard by nature, the Thug is short, curvy and has a flatter overall rocker for speed in mushy or slower surfing conditions. It works well as a tri fin or as a quad. The Thug is ready for busting airs and is a great summer alternative for average conditions and is a very functional surfboard for reef breaks and beach breaks in the San Diego area. The low amount of nose and tail rocker make this surfboard fast and able to defy mushy conditions.

models.name: Tongue Depressor
models.description: Tongue Depressor The Tongue Depressor is a new surfboard by Sauritch Surfboards, that was created for very small summer waves and as a surfboard that can take the place of a longboard. You can still get up to the nose on this board, due to the overall nose width. This model works really well as a quad, but can be ordered as a 5 fin. The rocker is very flat for planing speed and is pretty flat on the bottom in the forward section, blending into a deeper double concave between the fins with a small amount of "V" in the last 12" of the tail.

models.name: Tube Seeker
models.description: Tube Seeker This semi-gun surfboard is a must for the hard-core surfer that searches for big barrels all over the globe. Having a narrower outline makes this surfboard fast down an open face, as well as speeding through an upcoming tube. The pulled-in tail facilitates great holding power during the most critical turns. Added lift in the tail area creates ease in turning and eliminates that stiff feeling felt in some guns.

models.name: Twin Pintail
models.description: Twin Pintail For those of you that are craving that loose feeling of a twin fin in your quiver, the Twin Pintail will work in all conditions, with great holding power, due to its narrow, pulled in tail. This model works well in hollow conditions and comes with a mild, single to double concave bottom and slight "V" in the back end of the tail. The rails are fuller, which helps to get into the wave quicker. The tail is thinned out, to help bury the rail, during hard bottom turns.

models.name: Ultra Performer
models.description: Ultra Performer The Ultra Performer was designed for riding very hollow waves, where making really tight turns at high speeds, is a requirement. The addition of more nose and tail rocker and thinner, more sensitive rails, enables this surfboard to perform best in hollow conditions. This model comes standard with a squash tail, but can be ordered with any other desired tail shape. Try it as a tri fin or a 5 fin, for more versatility.

models.name: Water Moccasin
models.description: Water Moccasin The Water Mocassin is a new wide model, in the Sauritch Surfboards line of shortboards. Not only does this surfboard paddle very well, but it's incredibly fast and climbs from top to bottom really quickly. The bottom starts out as a single concave and blends into a double concave with a slight "V" out the tail. This is a very loose and fast surfboard!

models.name: Wish Fish
models.description: Wish Fish The Wish Fish, is a high performance, very maneuverable and responsive surfboard for riding good waves in small to larger conditions. It is suited for all surfers and can be ridden in different wave types and excels in beachbreaks around the globe. The single to double concaves, make it really fast down-the-line, as well as driving off the bottom. Order as a tri fin or with 5 boxes, for extra fin configurations.

brands.name: Chowder Surfboard Co.
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped Pacific Northwest surfboards from Ryan Brooks in Portland — fishes, fun shapes, alternative craft, and longboards.

models.name: The Fish
models.description: One of the most versatile and user friendly crafts in the water, the fish is a timeless shape that will never go out of style. Perfect for a wide variety of waves, but really excels on long, walled up waves where you can take full advantage of the built in speed of this shape. Traditionally a twin fin setup, however works well as a quad.

models.name: Fun Shape
models.description: Fun shapes are just that: fun. Whether they are closer to a shortboard or longboard, Chowder fun shapes come in all sizes with one thing in common — they are user-friendly and a blast to ride. They catch waves and paddle easily, and allow you to maximize your time in the water.

models.name: Alternative
models.description: Want to get weird? Experiment with your wave-riding style and craft with an alternative shape. Pushing the boundaries of what’s considered acceptable, Chowder loves creating something different that you’ll enjoy.

models.name: Longboard
models.description: A longboard is a must-have in any PNW surfer’s quiver. Tons of glide, easy to paddle and catch waves with, and fun to noseride, Chowder longboards are built for keeping your wave count and stoke levels high.

The rocker and concaves have stayed the same as the SS2 with a moderated single and slight double concaves between the fins for a neutral feeling board underfoot. Still the all-time favourite go-to board for when the waves turn on. models.name: Twingle Mid
models.description: The Twingle is a great board for just about all conditions and any ability of the surfer. Designed as either a full single fin for that old school longer point style for drawn out turns and glide , a Single with side bites for more drive and performance or surf it with a twin only option for a slide rail turn feel. Three options on one board for a wide variety of waves and conditions. Glassing — Stock (6 x4x6) Rocker — Low continuous Concave — Rolled Double Concave to Vee Rails — Low rail Tail — Round pin, swallow Wave size – 1-6 feet

JCD three-stage rocker, fast out of the gate but generous enough to perform, matched with a straight single concave throughout giving the board instead speed and Zing ,Wider tail and pod enables great planning speed over flats and for landing spins . The wave slave carries more volume but still has a performance rail and feel when surfing. An everyday high-performance board that won't let you down. Glassing — Stock (4s x4x4) Rocker —JCD 3 stage performance Concave — Single Rails — Medium performance Carbon — Carbon Toe Patches Tail —…

The glide and trim really come to life when ridder 7’ or longer, while it is a fun and manoeuvrable egg design when ridden shorter. It can be tweaked to perform well from 1 to solid 6 ft. It features a mild entry roll under the nose transitioning into a single-to-double concave to spiral vee off the tail, soft round rails and lots of paddle power. The most versatile design…

models.name: Bar of Soap
models.description: 5'7" ~ 20 1/2" ~ 2 1/2" @ 33 litres Clear deck inlay - Acrylic band - Teal bottom 6 oz + 4 oz deck - 6 bottom The Bar of Soap is our re-interpretation of the classic Mini Simmons with a more performance twist. It’s designed for surf in the 1ft - 4 ft range. It really catches every ripple and the wide tail is ideal to fly though flat sections in mushy surf. It generates speed effortlessly, but feels solid and reliable on the bottom turn with heaps of release off the top. Slight entry vee into double concave, which blends into a double channel for extra hold (channels normally recommended for a twin fin set up), domed deck and balanced shortboard rails. It is well suited to be ridden either…

models.name: Commuter
models.description: 5'10" ~ 20 3/8" ~ 2 1/2" Acrylic stain on glass camo deck - Clear bottom 3/8" red cedar stringer 6 + 4 oz deck - 6 oz bottom Our tribute to the classic fish. It shines in clean waves, especially if set up as a twin fin. To be ridden as short as possible for the classic design, a fun board for clean beaches and point breaks. Relaxed rocker and full outline allow for lots of speed and paddle power. Entry vee to double concave to spiral vee to vee, it is very well suited for both a twin keel fin or a quad set up for more control. Featuring low rails and a refined swallow tail, it handles surf in the 2 ft to solid 5 ft surf, effortlessly generating speed and drawing smooth lines.

models.name: Blunt Fish
models.description: The Blunt Fish is the latest addition to our line up and represents the culmination of years of research and development. We experimented with the Simmons planing hull concept and applied to a series of different bottom rockers/contours/aspect ratios. The resulting board is a fish with enhanced performance. It flies through flat sections thanks to the relaxed bottom rocker, flattened out in the single channel off the tail and it still retains enough curve in the rail line to be pushed hard for more vertical surfing. The flat deck allows for extra foam to be packed in a compact outline. A super fun little rocket for both beach and point breaks. Explore the price list here . Please use the…

models.name: Solis
models.description: Exploring the enigmatic high 7’ to high 8’ range. The Solis is ideal for anyone looking to downsize from a longboard, opening up new lines but without sacrificing trim and flow. We love it both as a single fin or as a twin fin set up if surfed a bit shorter. It rides well in big open faces. Locked in the face of the wave when walking to the nose for heaps of trim, drive and release when stepping back and engaging the hard rail, all diluted in a longer board but still more compact than a longboard. Slight roll vee to panel vee, 60/40 to hard rails. The challenge for this relatively simple design was to find the right balance and blend all the soft transitions to create a giant sweet spot…

models.name: Goliath
models.description: 6'8" ~ 20" ~ 2 3/4" @ 39.5 litre Light buttery olive tint 6 + 4 oz deck - 6 oz bottom Designed for open-face, carvy, down-the-line surfing. It holds lines on steeper walls and it preforms at its best on the point breaks, especially on the good days . Single concave transitioning to double to vee. The flat deck and the homogeneous foil spreads out the sweet spot and allows to pack some extra foam under the chest. Available as a round pin (with or without flyers), it can be surfed as a twin, quad or as a twin plus stabilizer. It is also playful in smaller surf, especially with a diamond/square tail and if surfed a bit shorter.

models.name: Jumbo Fish
models.description: Ideal for down the line surfing, heaps of trim but with a performance twist. It really shines on the point breaks around the coast. We took everything we like about our fish and stretched to a longer rail line with more paddle power and hold in bigger surf. The latest edition of the design has a hip in the tail just behind the fins to help breaking the lines into sharper turns. Explore the price list here . Please use the custom surfboard order form for a detailed quote. 3D model: 7'3" ~ 21 5/8" ~ 3" @ 54 l.

models.name: Narwhal
models.description: Our mega classic nose rider log. We designed the Narwhal to be as easy as possible to surf, where all the curves are quite subtle and blend smoothly into each other. The results is a stable and forgiving board that doesn't bog rail, connects the flat sections and does all the work for you. Moderately rolled vee bottom all the way through, blending a single concave under the nose and a panel vee off the tail. Recommended to be surfed with a pivot fin to maximise the time on the nose or a dolphin-style fin for a smoother ride . Explore the price list here . Please use the custom surfboard order form for a detailed quote. 3D model: 9'6" ~ 23" ~ 3" @ 75.38 l.

models.name: Butter Quad
models.description: The Butter Quad has the DNA of a fish morphing into a more performance craft. Recommended to be ridden a couple of inches shorter than your thruster shortboard. This fish model is ultimately a refined version of the Commuter Fish. Both nose and tail are narrower, with a more aggressive rocker line. Single concave to vee off the tail, lower rails and refined swallow allow increased performance and control in more powerful surf. Explore the price list here . Please use the custom surfboard order form for a detailed quote. 3D model: 6'1" ~ 20" ~ 2 5/8" @ 34.5 l.

models.name: Flebo Twin
models.description: The Flebo Twin is one for all (most) conditions, intuitive and forgiving. Not as fast as a keel fish, but easier to control thanks to the more pulled-in tail and the twin plus stabilizer set up option that adds extra grip. It has the foil of a modern short board (surfer used to rider thrusters will find it somewhat familiar) with a relaxed rocker and fuller rails. It can be surfed shorter to sit tight in the pocket or more drawn out to hold longer lines on open face surf. 3D model: 6'1" ~ 19 5/8" ~ 2 5/8" @ 35.8 l.

No Wax needed on any Gboard.

This foam won’t allow any water to be absorbed, doubled with a super durable slick bottom and reinforced rubber nose and tail guards, its proven to be the most durable soft board available. The Gboard Originals are designed specifically for Surf Schools, to withstand the daily use under some of the most extreme (and fun) conditions that the Australian beaches can throw at them.
